english: An enumeration of seventy-two prophets and prophetesses. Concerning the Old Testament prophets and prophetesses, Epiphanius. 1. Adam. 2. Enoch. 3. Noah. 4. Abraham. 5. Isaac. 6. Jacob. 7. Moses. 8. Aaron. 9. Joshua. 10. Eldam. 11. Mordad. 12. Job. 13. Samuel. 14. Nathan. 15. David. 16. Gad. 17. Ithidoum. 18. Asaph. 19. Aiman. 20. Aitham. 21. Solomon. 22. Achias. 23. Semeas. 24. The man of God, Seth. 25. Eli, and also Shillum. 26. Joad. 27. Addow. 28. Azarias. 29. Anani, and also Ananias. 30. Jehu. 31. Michaias. 32. Elias. 33. Oziel. 34. Eliad. 35. Jesus, son of Ananius. 36. Elisha. 37. Jonathan.

ἔγνωμεν μέρος ἐλάχιστον προφητείας ἔχοντας ἢ καὶ προφάσει προφητικῇ, τοὺς δὲ
καὶ περιττότερόν τι προφητεύσαντας, τοὺς μὲν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἀδάμ, τοὺς δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν
καθεξῆς χρόνων, οὓς δεῖν ᾠήθην μὴ παραλεῖψαι αὖθις μετὰ τὸν ξγʹ ἀριθμόν, ἀλλὰ
συνάψαι τῇ τῆς ἀνακεφαλαιώσεως ἀκολουθίᾳ, οἷον καί εἰσιν οἷδε. ξδʹ. Ἐνώς. ξεʹ.
Μαθουσάλα. ξ ʹ. Λάμεχ. ξζʹ. Βαλαάμ. ξηʹ. Σαούλ. 3 ξθʹ. Ἀβιμέλεχ ὁ καὶ Ἀχιμέλεχ. οʹ.
english: We have known a very small part of prophecy, or even a prophetic appearance; but regarding those who also prophesied somewhat more abundantly, some from Adam and others from the successive years, it seems necessary for me not to leave them behind after the sixty-third number, but to join them to the sequence of the recapitulation, such as these are: 44. Enos. 45. Mahalalel. 46. Jared. 47. Enoch. 48. Methuselah. 49. Lamech. 50. Balaam. 51. Saul. 52. Abimelech, who is also Achimelech. 53.

english: Amos, 1st. Zadok, 2nd. the elder who is in Bethlehem. Agabus, who is in the Acts. AND THE PROPHETESSES: 1st. Sarah, 2nd. Rebecca, 3rd. Mary the sister of Moses, 4th. Deborah, 5th. Olda, 6th. Anna the mother of Samuel, 7th. Judith, 8th. Elizabeth, the mother of John, 9th. Anna the daughter of Phanuel, 10th. Mary the Theotokos.
